plugins.name: cockpit
plugins.description: One band above the prompt with Clawd, the Claude Code mascot, who reacts to what is happening: context, cache, 5-hour and weekly limits, tools at work, finished turns, permission prompts. Collapsed row of meters with an expand arrow, a speech bubble with the button for every warning, saver routing, preflight warnings, the prompt enhancer, and a chime. Replaces meters, saver, preflight-guard and prompt-enhancer.
